statement: The report and four-page inspected PDF describe additive Rust raw/closed degree-space and P/Q augmented-information diagnostics, using frozen unit/matrix/checker data claims. It distinguishes original-ideal membership from degree admission, raw from closed rank, scalar from coordinate fields, producer telemetry from verified work and original-versus-augmented diagnostics from strongest matched timing controls. It proposes prospectively declared joint closure-preserving pruning while retaining other degree caps and augmented information; no new hypothesis is measured. Existing trace/analyze and all maintained algorithms/tests are preserved, with additive correction of predecessor review. Partial ENOSPC, wrapper/metadata/rendering failures and canonical-history reconciliation are retained. Actual-root integration, F4 event-degree tracing, regularity/formal proofs, group bridge and the original repeated full-boundary15x goal remain open. Unsigned/unverified component evidence only.
